name: Buff Attack Small
desc: Increases your attack by 15%.
action: export function effect(card, target){ card.attack *= (1 + 0.15); }

name: Buff Attack Big
desc: Increases your attack by 40%.
action: export function effect(card, target){ card.attack *= (1 + 0.40); }

name: Buff Defense
desc: Increases your defense by 25%.
action: export function effect(card, target){ card.defense *= (1 + 0.25); }

name: Heal Small
desc: Heals 25% of your max HP.
action: export function effect(card, target){ card.hp += card.maxHp * 0.25; if(card.hp > card.maxHp) card.hp = card.maxHp; }

name: Heal All
desc: Heals 50% of all allies' max HP.
action: export function effect(card, targets){ targets.forEach(t=>{ t.hp += t.maxHp*0.5; if(t.hp>t.maxHp)t.hp=t.maxHp; }); }

name: Shield Small
desc: Creates a shield equal to 25% of your HP.
action: export function effect(card, target){ card.shield = (card.shield || 0) + card.maxHp*0.25; }

name: Burn
desc: Applies burn to the target.
action: export function effect(card, target){ target.status.burn = (target.status.burn || 0) + 1; }

name: Poison
desc: Applies poison for 3 turns.
action: export function effect(card, target){ target.status.poison = 3; }

name: Stun
desc: 25% chance to stun the target.
action: export function effect(card, target){ if(Math.random()<0.25) target.status.stun=true; }

name: Silence
desc: 20% chance to silence the target.
action: export function effect(card, target){ if(Math.random()<0.20) target.status.silence=true; }

name: Evade
desc: 40% chance to evade incoming attacks.
action: export function effect(card, target){ if(Math.random()<0.40) card.status.evade=true; }

name: Revive
desc: Revives 1 ally from the graveyard at full HP.
action: export function effect(card, targets){ let dead = targets.filter(t=>t.hp<=0); if(dead.length>0) dead[0].hp=dead[0].maxHp; }

name: Sacrifice Steal Power
desc: Sacrifices the strongest ally to gain 70% of its attack.
action: export function effect(card, allies){ let strongest = allies.sort((a,b)=>b.attack-a.attack)[0]; card.attack += strongest.attack*0.70; strongest.hp=0; }

name: Grave Lock
desc: Blocks the graveyard while alive.
action: export function effect(card, game){ game.graveLocked=true; }

name: Combo Boost
desc: Gains 10% attack per card of the same type on the field.
action: export function effect(card, allies){ let count = allies.filter(a=>a.type===card.type).length; card.attack *= (1 + 0.10*count); }

name: Reflect
desc: Reflects 25% of damage received.
action: export function effect(card, attacker, damage){ attacker.hp -= damage*0.25; }

name: Bleed
desc: Causes light bleeding to the target.
action: export function effect(card, target){ target.status.bleed = (target.status.bleed || 0) + 1; }

name: Rage Boost
desc: Gains 25% attack when hit.
action: export function effect(card, attacker){ card.attack *= 1.25; }

name: Regen
desc: Regenerates 20% of HP each turn.
action: export function effect(card){ card.hp += card.maxHp*0.20; if(card.hp>card.maxHp) card.hp=card.maxHp; }

name: Frost
desc: 15% chance to freeze the target.
action: export function effect(card, target){ if(Math.random()<0.15) target.status.stun=true; }

name: Curse
desc: Curses attacker to receive continuous damage.
action: export function effect(card, attacker){ attacker.status.curse = true; }

name: Siphon Life
desc: Steals 30% of damage dealt as healing.
action: export function effect(card, target){ let dmg = card.attack; target.hp -= dmg; card.hp += dmg*0.30; if(card.hp>card.maxHp) card.hp=card.maxHp; }

name: Bravery
desc: Increases your attack by 20% when starting the turn.
action: export function effect(card){ card.attack *= 1.20; }

name: Mirror Shield
desc: Reflects 30% of damage received.
action: export function effect(card, attacker, damage){ attacker.hp -= damage*0.30; }

name: Berserk
desc: Increases 50% attack when HP < 30%.
action: export function effect(card){ if(card.hp<card.maxHp*0.3) card.attack *= 1.5; }

name: Holy Aura
desc: Heals all living allies by 15% per turn.
action: export function effect(card, allies){ allies.forEach(t=>{ if(t.hp>0){ t.hp+=t.maxHp*0.15; if(t.hp>t.maxHp)t.hp=t.maxHp; } }); }

name: Dark Link
desc: Sacrifices 1 ally and gains 50% of its power.
action: export function effect(card, allies){ let ally = allies.find(a=>a.hp>0); if(ally){ card.attack+=ally.attack*0.5; ally.hp=0; } }

name: Grave Blessing
desc: Revives 1 random ally after defending.
action: export function effect(card, allies){ let dead = allies.filter(a=>a.hp<=0); if(dead.length>0){ let r = dead[Math.floor(Math.random()*dead.length)]; r.hp=r.maxHp; } }

name: Phoenix Soul
desc: Revives automatically once upon death.
action: export function effect(card){ if(!card.status.reviveUsed){ card.hp = card.maxHp; card.status.reviveUsed=true; } }

name: Skip Enemy Turn

name: Guardian's Wrath
desc: Deals 80 damage to target and 40 to adjacent cards.
action: export function effect(subject,target){ target.hp=Math.max(0,target.hp-80); target.cards.forEach(c=>{ c.hp=Math.max(0,c.hp-40); }); }

name: Final Judgment
desc: Deals 50% extra damage to targets below 50% HP.
action: export function effect(subject,target){ if(target.hp<target.maxHp*0.5) target.hp-=subject.attack*0.5; }
